rationale: No existing Logs-area spec covers the non-SQL multi-stream search behavior (UNION ALL BY NAME composition, _stream_name attribution, histogram suppression, visualize block). join.spec.js covers SQL-mode JOIN between two streams, not the non-SQL UNION ALL BY NAME path. crossLinkMultiStream.spec.js is a Dashboards cross-linking spec (different area). multiselect-stream.spec.js is Streams-area multi-select management. The feature is its own Logs area: create a new spec at the run-context spec_path and register it in the Logs-Core shard (run_files) of playwright.yml.
